stem: A child has chronic bowel symptoms, low total IgA, low tTG-IgA and small-bowel biopsy showing villous atrophy. Which diagnosis best fits these findings?
explanation: Villous atrophy on small-bowel biopsy is a key feature of coeliac disease. Low total IgA can make tTG-IgA falsely low, so the biopsy result is important in this scenario.
